# 5 Ways to Verify Employee Documents Online in India Without Hiring a Background Verification Agency


August 20, 2026


[Shashank Yadav](https://salarybox.in/blog/author/shashank87cc9f270b/)


[No comments yet](https://salarybox.in/blog/5-ways-to-verify-employee-documents-online-in-india-without-hiring-a-background-verification-agency/#respond)


You do not need a Rs 50,000 annual contract with a background verification agency to check whether your new hire’s PAN card is genuine. You do not need to wait 7 to 15 business days for a field agent to visit someone’s house and confirm their address. And you definitely do not need to schedule a demo call, sit through a sales pitch, and commit to minimum volumes before you can verify a single employee’s identity.


In 2026, Indian employers have multiple ways to verify employee documents online, directly against government databases, from any device with internet access, in minutes. The technology exists. The government APIs are live. The question is whether you know how to use them.


This guide walks you through five practical, proven methods to verify employee documents online in India. We cover what each method can and cannot do, what it costs, how fast it is, and which one is right for your company’s size and hiring volume.


## Why Online Document Verification Matters More Than Ever


Before we get into the methods, let us understand why online verification has become the standard.


### Paper Documents Are No Longer Trustworthy


The Kerala fake degree racket busted in December 2025 supplied an estimated one million counterfeit certificates. AI tools can now generate convincing fake PAN cards, Voter IDs, and educational certificates in minutes. A printed document, a photocopy, or even a scanned PDF is no longer sufficient proof that a document is genuine.


The only way to confirm a document’s authenticity is to check it against the issuing authority’s database. That means going digital.


### Agency Timelines Do Not Match Modern Hiring Speed


Traditional verification agencies take 7 to 15 business days for standard checks. In a job market where top candidates receive multiple offers within days, a two-week verification delay means you lose talent to faster competitors.


Digital verification returns identity check results in minutes. The candidate can be verified before their interview chair is cold.


### The Cost Gap Is Enormous


A traditional agency charges Rs 1,500 to Rs 5,000 per candidate for a standard verification package. A digital PAN or Voter ID check costs Rs 50 to Rs 200. For a company hiring 50 people a year, the annual savings from switching to digital verification can exceed Rs 1 lakh.


## Method 1: Self-Serve Digital Verification Platforms


### What They Are


Self-serve platforms let you verify employee documents online without sales calls, contracts, or minimum volumes. You create an account, enter the employee’s document details, select the checks you want, see the price, pay, and get results.


These platforms use API integrations with government databases (Income Tax Department for PAN, Election Commission for Voter ID, VAHAN/SARATHI for Driving Licence, EPFO for UAN) to return authoritative verification results.


### What You Can Verify


**PAN Card.** Enter the PAN number. The platform checks it against the Income Tax Department database and returns the name and date of birth associated with that PAN. If the returned details match the employee’s claims, the PAN is genuine and belongs to them.


**Voter ID (EPIC).** Enter the EPIC number. The platform checks it against the Election Commission database and returns the name, date of birth, and registered address. Provides independent identity confirmation.


**Driving Licence.** Enter the DL number. The platform checks it against VAHAN/SARATHI and returns licence validity, vehicle class, issue and expiry dates, and any suspensions.


**UAN (Employment History).** Enter the Universal Account Number. The platform checks it against EPFO records and returns previous employer names and employment dates through PF contribution history.

## Method 2: Government Portal Direct Checks


### What They Are


Several Indian government portals allow you to verify specific documents directly, without any third-party platform.


### Available Government Portals


**PAN Verification.** The Income Tax Department’s PAN verification portal (incometaxindiaefiling.gov.in) allows you to verify a PAN number. However, access is limited. Bulk verification requires a registered TAN (Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number). Individual lookups return limited information.


**Voter ID Verification.** The National Voter Service Portal (voters.eci.gov.in) lets you search for a voter by EPIC number. It returns basic details including name and polling station area.


**Driving Licence Verification.** The Parivahan portal (parivahan.gov.in) offers a “Know Your Driving Licence” feature where you can enter a DL number and date of birth to check validity.


**EPFO Portal.** The EPFO Member portal (unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in) requires the employee’s own login credentials, so it is not practical for employer-initiated verification.


### Limitations


Government portals are designed for individual lookups, not for employer verification workflows. They do not offer batch processing, they do not generate verification reports, they do not run cross-record analysis, and the information returned is often limited. The EPFO portal requires the employee’s own credentials, making employer-side verification impractical.


These portals are useful for a quick spot check on a single document, but they are not a scalable verification solution.


### Who This Is Best For


Individual freelancers or very small businesses that need to verify one or two documents occasionally and do not need formal verification reports.


## Method 3: KYC and Identity Verification APIs


### What They Are


Several Indian companies offer identity verification APIs that developers can integrate directly into their HR software, applicant tracking systems, or onboarding workflows. These APIs connect to the same government databases as self-serve platforms but allow programmatic access.


### How They Work


Your development team integrates the API into your HR system. When a new employee is onboarded, the system automatically sends their PAN, Voter ID, or DL number to the API, receives the verification response, and stores the result in the employee’s record. No manual data entry, no separate platform logins.


### Providers


Several Indian companies offer verification APIs, including IDfy, Karza Technologies, Gridlines, SignDesk, and others. Pricing is typically per API call, ranging from Rs 2 to Rs 20 per check depending on volume commitments and the specific check type.


### Limitations


API integration requires a development team. You need someone who can write code, handle API authentication, parse responses, and maintain the integration. For companies without in-house developers, this is not a practical option.


API providers also typically require registration, KYC of your business, and sometimes minimum volume commitments before providing access.


### Who This Is Best For


Mid-to-large companies with in-house development teams that want to embed verification directly into their existing HR or ATS software. Companies processing hundreds or thousands of verifications per month where automation is essential.


## Method 4: Professional Background Verification Platforms (Digital-First Agencies)


### What They Are


These are background verification companies that operate primarily through digital platforms rather than field agents. They offer the same check types as traditional agencies but use technology to deliver faster results at lower costs.


### How They Differ from Traditional Agencies


Traditional agencies rely heavily on field agents for physical document inspection, address visits, and in-person reference checks. Digital-first platforms use API-based verification for identity checks (instant results), eCourts database searches for criminal record checks (24 to 72 hours instead of 7 to 14 days), and digital institutional verification for education checks.


### What They Offer Beyond Identity Checks


Criminal record checks through eCourts database integration. Education verification through institutional contact. Address verification through database cross-referencing. Reference checks through structured digital questionnaires. Drug screening coordination (for companies that require it).


### Limitations


These platforms are more comprehensive than pure identity verification but also more expensive. Per-candidate costs typically range from Rs 800 to Rs 3,000 for standard packages. Many still require sales conversations, demos, and annual contracts for full access.


### Who This Is Best For


Companies that need checks beyond identity and employment history (criminal records, education, address) but want faster results than traditional agencies provide.


## Method 5: EPFO and UAN Self-Check for Employment History


### What It Is


The EPFO (Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation) maintains employment records for every formal sector employee in India through their UAN (Universal Account Number). While the employer-side EPFO portal has access restrictions, there are legitimate ways to verify employment history.


### How to Use It


**Ask the employee to share their EPFO passbook.** Employees can download their PF passbook from the EPFO Member portal. The passbook shows every employer that deposited PF contributions, the contribution amounts, and the contribution dates. This effectively provides a verified employment history.


**UAN verification through a platform.** Platforms like[Compose1 Verify](https://compose1.com/verify/) can check UAN details against EPFO records and return the employment history associated with the UAN. This is faster and more reliable than asking the employee to share a passbook screenshot, which could potentially be edited.


### What It Reveals


Previous employer names (legal entity names as registered with EPFO). Employment dates (PF contribution start and end dates, which roughly correspond to joining and leaving dates). Contribution amounts (which can indicate salary ranges). Multiple UAN numbers (which might indicate undisclosed employment).


### Limitations


Not all employers deposit PF, especially smaller companies, startups, and companies where the employee’s salary was below the PF threshold. Contract workers and freelancers may have no EPFO records at all. Employment dates in EPFO records often lag behind actual dates by one to two months due to PF registration and processing timelines.


EPFO’s 2025-26 data masking rules have made manual portal viewing less reliable, making API-based UAN verification through platforms like Compose1 Verify more important than ever.


### Who This Is Best For


Any employer who wants to verify a candidate’s claimed employment history. UAN verification is particularly valuable for mid-level and senior hires where experience claims are a critical factor in the hiring decision.


## Comparing the Five Methods


### Speed


Self-serve platforms: minutes. Government portals: minutes (but limited data). APIs: seconds (once integrated). Digital-first agencies: hours to days. EPFO self-check: minutes to hours.


### Cost Per Check


Self-serve platforms: Rs 50 to Rs 500. Government portals: free. APIs: Rs 2 to Rs 20 (but integration costs). Digital-first agencies: Rs 800 to Rs 3,000. EPFO self-check through platform: Rs 200 to Rs 500.


### Ease of Use


Self-serve platforms: anyone can use, no technical skills needed. Government portals: basic, limited features. APIs: requires developers. Digital-first agencies: account manager assisted. EPFO self-check: moderate.


### Report Quality


Self-serve platforms: PDF reports with cross-record analysis. Government portals: screen display only, no formal reports. APIs: raw data, you build your own reports. Digital-first agencies: comprehensive multi-check reports. EPFO self-check: passbook format.


### Scalability


Self-serve platforms: scales with pay-per-check pricing. Government portals: not scalable. APIs: highly scalable once integrated. Digital-first agencies: scalable with contracts. EPFO self-check: one at a time.

For the majority of Indian companies, the optimal approach combines methods based on need.


**For every hire:** Use a self-serve platform like[Compose1 Verify](https://compose1.com/verify/) to run PAN and Voter ID checks. Takes minutes, costs under Rs 400, and confirms identity against government databases. Add Driving Licence verification for roles involving vehicles. Add UAN for mid-level and above roles.


**For roles requiring criminal or education checks:** Layer a digital-first agency’s services on top of the identity checks already completed through the self-serve platform.


**For high-volume, tech-forward companies:** Integrate verification APIs into your HR system for automated screening at scale.


This hybrid approach gives you the speed and affordability of digital verification for the most common checks while maintaining access to comprehensive screening when specific roles require it.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### Can I legally verify an employee’s PAN card online without their consent?


No. Under the DPDP Act 2023, you must obtain the employee’s explicit consent before processing any personal data, including running a PAN verification. Always collect consent before initiating any check.


### Are online verification results legally valid?


Yes. Results from government database API checks (Income Tax Department, Election Commission, VAHAN/SARATHI, EPFO) are authoritative data from the issuing authority. They carry the same legal weight as any other form of verification.


### How do I verify documents for candidates in rural areas?


Digital verification works identically regardless of location. PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, and UAN are national databases. A candidate from a village in Rajasthan is verified against the same databases as a candidate from Mumbai. No field agent travel required.


### What if the government portal is down when I need to verify?


Government portals experience periodic downtime. This is one reason to use self-serve platforms like[Compose1 Verify](https://compose1.com/verify/) instead of directly accessing government portals. Verification platforms manage API connectivity, handle retries, and provide more reliable access than direct portal use.


### Can I verify an employee’s Aadhaar card online?


Aadhaar verification for employment purposes is restricted under the Aadhaar Act. Private employers generally cannot use Aadhaar for employee verification without specific legal authorization. Use PAN and Voter ID as identity verification alternatives instead.


### How many employees can I verify at once through an online platform?


There is no limit on self-serve platforms like Compose1 Verify. You can verify one employee or five hundred in a single session. Pay-per-check pricing means you pay only for the checks you run, with no volume minimums or maximums.
